title: 安田記念の後に・夢集う未来へ！

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff, huff…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ngh… I lost!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: That was so close, Oguri! You'll get it next time! I know you will!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: You were phenomenal! I'll be there to cheer you on in your next race too, so don't give up!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I can't believe it! Oguri's already fully recovered from the race!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And here I am, still wheezing and dying… I've got to get even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You were incredible today. Your passion was so hot, I thought it might burn me… It really pushed me to perform even better than usual.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Let's race again someday.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: O-of course! I wouldn't miss it!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Until then.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: How…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: How were you able to face Oguri so fearlessly? How did you perform so admirably in the face of such terrifying strength?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: When I came up against that same unbelievable force, all I could do was think about how much stronger she was… and how powerless I was.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But that unbelievable power of hers is exactly what makes her such a great rival!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm so glad I have such a crazy strong racer like Oguri paving the way ahead of me!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: The stronger she is, the more exhilarating it'll be when I finally beat her! It's a seemingly impossible challenge with a seemingly invincible foe!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's why, for me, Oguri's not someone who devours dreams! It's the total opposite!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: She's like a towering GIANT, egging me on to take her down! She's the one who lit this fire in me, and now my dreams and I both burn bright!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …I see. I never realized how different the two of us are.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I suppose at some point I must have forgotten the mindset necessary to take on such towering adversaries.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Do you think I can do it as well?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Can I face strong opponents head-on the way you do?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Of course you can!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: After all, you're the one who taught me that you can improve yourself by facing strong opponents in the first place!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I shall reclaim my initial mindset and set out once more to face mighty opponents.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'll continue chasing my dream!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Look at Yaeno's face! Doesn't she look a little more positive? Thank goodness!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'm sure she sensed the same thing that we did from Bamboo's magnificent run.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: There is simply no one more dedicated to her dreams than Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It's like watching her gives you the strength to chase your own!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes, I couldn't agree more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory and I finally get back to campus. She was quieter than usual on our way back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But suddenly, she stops in her tracks.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You were incredible today. Your passion was so hot, I thought it might burn me… It really pushed me to perform even better than usual.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Let's race again someday.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I look back, I notice tears welling up in her eyes!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why do you a—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Agh, why are my eyes all watery?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Whoa, hold on! I'm fine, I swear!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm totally fine! I'm just…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: After all this time, I was fiiinally able to throw everything I had at Oguri in a G1 race!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It just makes me sooo happy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Without warning, large tears start spilling down Bamboo Memory's face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This is not only the quietest I've ever seen her, but also the most raw and emotional.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I knew it! From the moment I started running, it's always been my destiny to face her!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: She's the one who stands at the very center of my dream. She's my ultimate rival—a part of my story!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: So maybe that's why…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I wanna be a part of Oguri Cap's story too.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I want her and everyone else to say Bamboo Memory is Oguri Cap's ultimate rival!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That's who I want to be!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And that's why I want to run in the Sprinters Stakes next!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: There, I'll prove myself as the best sprinter ever! I'll become the best version of myself and someone worthy of being Oguri's rival!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory's passion is so strong, I can feel my own eyes begin to water.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As her trainer, this is where I have to step up! If she wants to become Oguri Cap's rival, then I know just what she needs to do!
choice_data_list: Let's run in the Takarazuka Kinen first.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Huh?! But that's a medium-distance race!
choice_data_list: It'll definitely be tough on you, but…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: But?
choice_data_list: Chiyono O and Yaeno will be there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And not just them. The best racers in this generation are sure to make an appearance. The Takarazuka Kinen is a grand prix, after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bamboo Memory has nurtured an increasingly strong passion for her dream thanks to the time she's spent with Yaeno Muteki and the rest of her peers.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she competes in a race where so many of her generation's dreams collide…
choice_data_list: I know it'll make you even stronger!
I know it'll make you even stronger!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Okay, then! Takarazuka Kinen, here I come!
